title: What's The Plan?
tagline: Say bye to scribbled notes, abandoned plans or the never ending search for the perfect hangout spot. WTP(What's the plan) is a one-stop planning platform that allows you to search, make lists, share, and even earn credits.
description:
This project aims to make planning easier and fun. One can search for places, food, drinks books, the perfect date place or a trip with your homies using the search API and add them to create a list. The lists created can be shared with people who can upvote or downvote the list.
People can search for the best weekend plans or the best breakfast places around the area. As you improve your credentials and visibility, you can even make customized plans for users and earn credits.
how_its_made:
This project uses the Moralis framework, IPFS, Polygon network, and Maps API.

A user can log in using Metamask and explore existing plans.

A new plan can be created by searching locations and places using places API which is stored on IPFS.

You can create, edit and organise your plans and upvotes plans that are trending at the call of an API
